deadline.value: No common call or admission date: departments advertise positions continuously during the year, each open for at least three weeks before its deadline
deadline.quote: The faculty has no common call or admission date, but calls are made continuously during the year. | The announcement shall be available locally and on the university's website at least three weeks before the application deadline

also.quote: Rather than apply for a doctoral programme, candidates must apply for an available doctoral position.

app_fee.value: No application or tuition fee for the PhD programme, whatever your citizenship
app_fee.quote: Application and tuition fees for PhD students | PhD programmes are free of charge in Sweden, regardless of citizenship.

fee_waiver.quote: PhD programmes are free of charge in Sweden, regardless of citizenship.

supervisor.value: Admission is decided after consultation with the supervisors, who normally set the main structure of the research project at admission
supervisor.quote: Admission is decided after consultation with the supervisors at the department/division. Normally, the supervisors formulate the main structure of the research project in connection with the admission.

funding.value: On admission the department commits to four years of full-time funding, normally as an employed doctoral student. Scholarships are used restrictively and must be topped up to the employed-student level
funding.quote: All doctoral students must have adequate means of support throughout their studies. When admitting doctoral students, the department therefore undertakes to provide funding for four years of full-time study at doctoral level. | The primary means of support for doctoral students awarded admission is employment as a doctoral student (a doctoral studentship). | The Faculty Board has decided that scholarships are to be used restrictively. | The department must ensure that a doctoral student funded by a scholarship is in a net financial position that at least matches that of a doctoral student employed by the University

also.quote: Uppsala University, like most universities in Sweden, regards PhD students as employees.

entry_route.value: A second-cycle (master's) degree, or 240 credits with at least 60 at second-cycle level including a 15-credit independent project; Physics also requires at least 90 credits in physics or related courses
entry_route.quote: General entry requirements correspond to a degree at second-cycle level, or 240 credits (of which at least 60 credits at second-cycle level including an independent project of at least 15 credits), or otherwise acquired equivalent knowledge.

also.quote: A person meets the special eligibility requirements for doctoral studies in Physics if she/he has passed examinations in courses in Physics or in courses in areas of relevance to Physics, covering a minimum of 90 higher education credits

notes: Physics and Theoretical Physics have separate general syllabuses under the Faculty of Science and Technology. The university PhD page requires 'good English language skills' but gives no test minimum, so check each advertisement. The funding rules come from a Faculty staff page.
